what: replay of the stored certificate corpus behind eight of the seventeen published-table rows through the certified checker's current build

corpus.source: supermartingales/out/sec2/rows-certs.tar.zst (stored plain-text row listings, pinned per file in supermartingales/MANIFEST.jsonl)
corpus.identity: 4105/4105 extracted listings sha256-match their manifest pins; the sealed input containers replayed here were compiled from those listings, and the compiled bodies' listings byte-match the stored ones (headers aside)

checker.name: qtslab (the certified checker; see the book's front matter for its overall standing)
checker.theorem_note: the machine-code theorem over this emission (HOL4, through the CakeML verified compiler) was re-established at the same emission: a run of the emitted code that prints ACCEPT with a sequent implies the logic-level checker function accepts those bytes with that sequent

agreement.fast_path_at_seal: accept x 4105 (seal-twin-verdicts.tsv): the untrusted fast-path twin, run when each container was sealed
agreement.reference_lane: the stored listings are additionally gated by this repository's reference-checker lane (the supermartingales make target)

protocol.machine: NVIDIA GB10 (Arm Cortex-X925 cores), aarch64; one single-threaded checker process per certificate
protocol.parallelism: four families concurrently, serial within each family
protocol.walls: single-shot per certificate; a serial 3-run spot sample (2 certificates x 4 families) ran 0.01-0.05 s, so the census walls carry mild concurrency inflation at most

files.census.tsv: one row per certificate: family, certificate stem, exit code, first verdict line, wall-clock seconds
files.seal-twin-verdicts.tsv: one row per certificate: certificate stem, seal-time fast-path verdict, and an auxiliary count recorded by the sealing run (not consumed by the table generator)

not_yet_public: the certified build itself (its emitted assembly and the HOL4 development that emits and proves it) and the container-sealing tool have not yet migrated into the public trees; per the chapter's reproduction section, their mention here is a statement of what exists, not yet a link
